nodes.name: Morning Brief Trigger
nodes.notes: FR11. Fixed hour (7am), same style as retention-sweep.json's 'Every day at 3am' -- n8n's Schedule Trigger has no per-workflow timezone expression field (it evaluates against the n8n instance's own configured timezone), so this ASSUMES the n8n host's configured timezone matches settings.timezone (default Asia/Colombo). The 'today'/'overnight' DATE MATH inside this branch is still computed correctly against settings.timezone regardless (via AT TIME ZONE) -- only the trigger's wall-clock firing hour depends on this assumption. See the placeholders sticky note.

nodes.name: MB: Read settings
nodes.notes: FR16. Same pattern as assistant-brain.json's 'Read settings' -- alwaysOutputData=true so an unconfigured account still yields a pass-through item, and 'MB: Prepare timezone' falls back to the column default.

nodes.name: MB: Read tasks due today

parameters.query: SELECT id, task_text FROM tasks WHERE status IN ('todo','in-progress') AND deadline = (now() AT TIME ZONE $1)::date ORDER BY deadline ASC;

nodes.notes: FR11 part 1. Same timezone-aware 'today' calculation as assistant-brain.json's /today command.

nodes.name: MB: Read open commitments

parameters.query: SELECT id, text, direction FROM commitments WHERE status = 'open' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10;

nodes.notes: FR11 part 2. executeOnce=true -- same reason as every other parameterless read chained after a variable-row-count node in this project (draft-generation.json's 'Read style sample').

nodes.name: MB: Read overnight count

parameters.query: SELECT count(*) FROM emails WHERE received_at >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE $1))::timestamp AT TIME ZONE $1;

nodes.notes: FR11 part 3 ('overnight' = since local midnight). date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE $1) gives local midnight as a naive timestamp; casting back AT TIME ZONE $1 converts it to the correct UTC instant for comparison against received_at (timestamptz). Reads timezone via node-name reference since it sits three nodes downstream of 'MB: Prepare timezone'.

nodes.name: MB: Read unhandled urgent

parameters.query: SELECT id, subject FROM emails WHERE priority = 'urgent' AND status = 'open' ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 10;

nodes.notes: FR11 part 4. Same query as assistant-brain.json's /urgent command.

nodes.name: MB: Format brief
nodes.notes: FR11.

nodes.name: MB: Loop chat IDs
nodes.notes: BEST-EFFORT, not live-verified: assumes n8n's Split In Batches output order is [0]=done, [1]=loop -- same assumption gmail-renewal-recovery.json's 'Loop Over Message IDs' documents and flags for on-import verification.

nodes.name: MB: Call Telegram Send
nodes.notes: onError=continueRegularOutput (learnings.md L28: one bad row/send must never block the rest of the batch) -- a failed send to one chat ID does not stop the loop from reaching the others.

nodes.name: Urgent/VIP Poll Trigger
nodes.notes: FR12. 5-minute interval is a starting guess (design.md Notes), not measured.

nodes.name: UP: Read urgent/VIP candidates

parameters.query: SELECT DISTINCT e.id, e.subject, e.received_at FROM emails e LEFT JOIN contacts c ON e.participants @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('address', c.email)) WHERE (e.priority = 'urgent' OR c.is_vip = true) AND e.status = 'open' ORDER BY e.received_at DESC;

nodes.notes: FR12: unhandled (status='open') emails that are either priority='urgent' or from a contacts.is_vip=true sender. Deliberately unfiltered by bot_notifications here -- dedup is computed per (chat_id, email_id) pair in 'UP: Expand unsent alerts' below, since bot_notifications_urgent_alert_uidx is scoped per chat_id, not globally per email.

nodes.name: UP: Read existing alerts

parameters.query: SELECT chat_id, email_id FROM bot_notifications WHERE notification_type = 'urgent_alert';

nodes.notes: Snapshot of every (chat_id, email_id) pair already notified, used to filter the candidate x chat_id expansion below.

nodes.name: UP: Loop unsent alerts
nodes.notes: BEST-EFFORT, not live-verified: same [0]=done/[1]=loop output-order assumption as gmail-renewal-recovery.json's 'Loop Over Message IDs'.

nodes.name: UP: Call Telegram Send
nodes.notes: onError=continueRegularOutput (learnings.md L28) -- one failed send must not stop the rest of the batch, and per this row's own contract must still fall through to 'UP: Insert notification' so a delivered-but-erroring response doesn't skip the dedup write and cause a resend next poll. A genuinely undelivered message re-sends next cycle instead (acceptable per spec.md's missed-push edge case), which is preferable to silently blocking every later candidate in the same run.

nodes.name: UP: Insert notification

parameters.query: INSERT INTO bot_notifications (chat_id, notification_type, email_id) VALUES ($1, 'urgent_alert', $2) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('UP: Loop unsent alerts').item.json.chat_id, $('UP: Loop unsent alerts').item.json.email_id] }}

nodes.notes: AC6/AC10: ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING against bot_notifications_urgent_alert_uidx -- belt-and-braces alongside the read-time filter in 'UP: Expand unsent alerts', guarding the (small) race window between that read and this write within a single poll run. onError=continueRegularOutput so a write failure doesn't stop the rest of the batch (L28). CORRECTED 2026-09-20 (live error: 'null value in column "chat_id" ... violates not-null constraint'): queryReplacement originally read $json.chat_id/$json.email_id directly, but by this point $json is 'UP: Call Telegram Send's OWN return value ({success, message_id}) -- an executeWorkflow node replaces the item entirely with its sub-workflow's output, it doesn't merge. Confirmed live: this silently no-op'd the dedup write on every poll (masked by onError=continueRegularOutput), so the same 3 urgent emails re-sent every 5-minute cycle instead of once. Fixed by reading $('UP: Loop unsent alerts').item.json instead -- the node immediately before the Telegram Send call, still carrying the original {chat_id, email_id, subject}.

nodes.name: Deadline Nudge Trigger
nodes.notes: FR13. Fixed hour (8am), same instance-timezone assumption as 'Morning Brief Trigger'.

nodes.name: DN: Read settings
nodes.notes: FR16.

nodes.name: DN: Read due/overdue tasks

parameters.query: SELECT id, task_text, deadline FROM tasks WHERE status IN ('todo','in-progress') AND deadline IS NOT NULL AND deadline <= (now() AT TIME ZONE $1)::date ORDER BY deadline ASC;

nodes.notes: FR13: 'today or earlier', not just today -- a task overdue for a week still needs exactly one nudge (the dedup row, once written, prevents any repeat regardless of how many more days it stays open).

nodes.name: DN: Read existing nudges

parameters.query: SELECT chat_id, task_id FROM bot_notifications WHERE notification_type = 'deadline_nudge';

nodes.notes: Snapshot for the candidate x chat_id filter, same shape as 'UP: Read existing alerts'.

nodes.name: DN: Loop unsent nudges
nodes.notes: BEST-EFFORT, not live-verified: same [0]=done/[1]=loop output-order assumption as gmail-renewal-recovery.json's 'Loop Over Message IDs'.

nodes.name: DN: Call Telegram Send
nodes.notes: onError=continueRegularOutput (L28), same reasoning as 'UP: Call Telegram Send'.

nodes.name: DN: Insert notification

parameters.query: INSERT INTO bot_notifications (chat_id, notification_type, task_id) VALUES ($1, 'deadline_nudge', $2) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('DN: Loop unsent nudges').item.json.chat_id, $('DN: Loop unsent nudges').item.json.task_id] }}

nodes.notes: AC7/AC10: ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING against bot_notifications_deadline_nudge_uidx. CORRECTED 2026-09-20: same $json-after-executeWorkflow bug found live in 'UP: Insert notification' (see its notes) -- fixed here pre-emptively the same way, reading $('DN: Loop unsent nudges').item.json instead of $json, which by this point would be 'DN: Call Telegram Send's own {success, message_id} return value.

nodes.name: Evening Review Trigger
nodes.notes: FR14. Fixed hour (7pm), same instance-timezone assumption as 'Morning Brief Trigger'.

nodes.name: ER: Read settings
nodes.notes: FR16.

nodes.name: ER: Read done today

parameters.query: SELECT id, task_text FROM tasks WHERE status = 'done' AND deadline = (now() AT TIME ZONE $1)::date;

nodes.notes: FR14 part 1, APPROXIMATE by necessity: tasks has no completed-at timestamp (0009_tasks_enrichment.sql adds owner/priority/origin/confidence, not a completion time), so 'done today' cannot be computed exactly. This uses status='done' AND deadline=today as the closest available proxy -- a task completed today but due on a different date will not appear here. Flagged honestly rather than silently wrong; revisit if a tasks.completed_at column is ever added.

nodes.name: ER: Read still open today

parameters.query: SELECT id, task_text FROM tasks WHERE status IN ('todo','in-progress') AND deadline = (now() AT TIME ZONE $1)::date;

nodes.notes: FR14 part 2 (what slipped). executeOnce=true, timezone read by node-name reference (see 'MB: Read overnight count' for the same convention).

nodes.name: ER: Read due tomorrow

parameters.query: SELECT id, task_text FROM tasks WHERE status IN ('todo','in-progress') AND deadline = (now() AT TIME ZONE $1)::date + 1;

nodes.notes: FR14 part 3.

nodes.name: ER: Format review
nodes.notes: FR14.

nodes.name: ER: Expand to chat IDs
nodes.notes: FR15 -- no dedup write, same reasoning as 'MB: Expand to chat IDs'.

nodes.name: ER: Loop chat IDs
nodes.notes: BEST-EFFORT, not live-verified: same [0]=done/[1]=loop output-order assumption as gmail-renewal-recovery.json's 'Loop Over Message IDs'.

nodes.name: ER: Call Telegram Send
nodes.notes: onError=continueRegularOutput (L28), same reasoning as 'MB: Call Telegram Send'.

parameters.content:
## Assistant Scheduler

One workflow, four independent Schedule Trigger chains (design.md's Architecture): Morning Brief (daily digest, no dedup), Urgent/VIP Poll (every 5 min, per-entity dedup via bot_notifications), Deadline Nudge (daily, per-entity dedup), Evening Review (daily digest, no dedup). Every send goes through telegram-send.json; the two per-entity pushes additionally write bot_notifications (0014_bot_notifications.sql) guarded by its partial unique indexes.

See .specclaw/changes/012-assistant-bot/spec.md (FR11-FR16) and design.md (Architecture, Data Model Changes).

### Placeholders to fill in on import

- **Supabase Postgres** credential on every Postgres node -- reuse the existing credential, do not create a new one.
- Every 'Call Telegram Send' node references the 'Telegram Send' sub-workflow by name (workflowId.value blank) -- re-point each at the real imported workflow via the resource picker once telegram-send.json is imported.
- **TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_CHAT_IDS** must already be set (same env var telegram-adapter.json reads).
- Migration 0014_bot_notifications.sql must be applied before activating this workflow -- 'UP:'/'DN:' branches read and write it immediately.
- The three fixed trigger hours (7am Morning Brief, 8am Deadline Nudge, 7pm Evening Review) assume the n8n instance's own configured timezone matches settings.timezone (default Asia/Colombo) -- adjust the Schedule Trigger nodes' hours directly if the instance runs in a different timezone, since n8n's Schedule Trigger has no per-workflow timezone field to parametrize instead.
- 'ER: Read done today' is a documented approximation (deadline=today AND status='done', no completed-at column exists) -- see that node's own notes.

nodes.name: MB: Insert notification
nodes.notes: 0018_bot_observability.sql, option B1: logs the digest send for the /bot page's activity log and stats. No dedup key -- Morning Brief Trigger already fires at most once/day (012-assistant-bot FR15), so a second row here means a second genuine send, not a re-fire. onError=continueRegularOutput (L28 pattern): a failed log write must not stop the loop from reaching the remaining chat IDs. NOT LIVE-VERIFIED -- see docs/setup/bot-observability-setup.md.
